purpose: Three fresh preview directions after v1 was rejected

assets.title: 折页印记
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create exactly ONE finished square Windows/macOS application icon, not a presentation sheet. This is a fresh alternative for 知屿 / Zhiyu, a beautifully designed personal reading, learning and daily-planning application. No text, no letters, no labels, no existing brand marks, no watermark. Build a strong, original silhouette readable at 24px. Center the emblem, generous intentional spacing, extremely polished professional app branding. Fully opaque image; full-bleed square background to all four edges, no transparent exterior or splatter. Do not recreate the previous open-book/mountain/sun illustration. No landscapes, no sun, no lightbulb, no graduation cap, no generic AI sparkle, no busy visual inventory.
Direction A — sophisticated graphic brand mark, confident and editorial. Rich burnt-coral / terracotta full-bleed field (#B6533D), mostly solid with only the slightest tonal material warmth. One large warm-ivory continuous folded-paper ribbon emblem, thick and sculptural in silhouette. It curves into an original compact asymmetric loop around a small leaf-shaped negative-space aperture, with one neatly folded bookmark tail; the geometry quietly suggests a personal place for collected thoughts. The ivory ribbon turns once and reveals ONE tiny muted apricot fold plane. This is a single coherent striking mark, not a book illustration and not a chain-link logo. Broad rounded joins with one crisp deliberate fold, impeccable optical balance, no hairline strokes, no texture grain, near-flat vector-like precision, no heavy 3D shadow. Emblem about 62% of square width, with a fresh silhouette that still works in monochrome. Do not draw a literal letter or infinity symbol.

assets.prompt:

Direction B — luxurious tactile desktop app object with restrained soft 3D. Deep midnight charcoal-green full-bleed background (#202E2A), subtle radial illumination. A single small exquisite CLOSED ivory research journal viewed in gentle three-quarter isometric perspective, centered, generously sized, softly rounded cream paper edges, a deep desaturated sage spine, and one thick terracotta fabric bookmark tab protruding from the top. The notebook has an almost blank warm-ivory cover, with a tiny debossed abstract island-shaped indentation as the sole cover detail. A narrow restrained amber light grazes the top edge. Handcrafted satin ceramic / fine paper material, realistic bevels, clear broad shapes; soft compact shadow only near the object. No desk, no pencils, no plant, no extra objects, no metal rings, no title, no symbol pile. A collectible premium tool icon, restrained, calm, distinctive, high contrast and very clean at small sizes.

assets.title: 纸屿
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create exactly ONE finished square Windows/macOS application icon, not a presentation sheet. Direction C — playful but refined folded-paper island emblem. Full-bleed very pale cool sage field (#DFE8DE). Center one compact sculptural origami form: TWO thick softly folded cream paper planes nest together into a gently asymmetric shelter / island silhouette, with a single bold vermilion folded underside visible at the lower right and one small deep-sage triangular fold visible at the upper left. It should feel like a little personal sanctuary made from one sheet of paper, viewed slightly from above. Not a boat, not a house icon, not a conventional open book, not a landscape. Geometric, tactile, rounded edges with precisely creased folds, minimal refined soft 3D, subtle contact shading, large distinct planes; iconic and friendly without a cartoon face. Shape fills about 66% of the square, strong clean white/red/green separation. No decorative scene or extraneous elements.
